cases.title: Starting a tortilla pinwheel: placing the tortilla and choosing the spread
cases.takeaway: Two visible errors, a question, an approval that could have been left unsaid, and a camera view that no longer shows the task.

moment_captions.T30_R0003: The user moves it to the board. An approval is welcome but optional: staying silent would have been fine.
moment_captions.T30_R0004: A question. The answer is useful from the moment the question ends.
moment_captions.T30_R0005: The jar is in hand, so what matters now is how to spread it.
moment_captions.T30_R0006: A spoon, not a knife. The window closes as soon as the user switches.
moment_captions.T30_R0007: The user holds up the knife and checks. A short confirmation is all that is needed.
moment_captions.T30_R0008: The workspace has left the camera view: the instructor can no longer see the task.
